info.name: ANPR API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the ANPR Django API, with sample bodies and real sample answers (open a request -> Examples).

1. Import this file and ANPR-local.postman_environment.json; pick the environment.
2. Fill in username and password in the environment.
3. Run Auth -> Log in: it saves the token for every other request.

Interactive docs: {{baseUrl}}/api/docs/ (Swagger) and {{baseUrl}}/api/redoc/.
Built by scripts/build_postman.py (make postman).

item.description: Log in first: it saves the token that every other request uses.
